proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3329 kurkura/kukkura explicitly means dog and gives Nepali kukur and neighboring kukar/kukur forms. The survey kukara/kukuru/kurkur shapes select this k-medial family, not kuttira with medial t. Exact survey form kʊkʌɾa is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10951 lamba gives Maithili namā long alongside regional lambā. Dang namba long is compared with this n-initial development, retaining mb rather than claiming an independently established local sound law. Exact survey form nʌmba is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12803.3 *kṣaṭ/*kṣvaṭ gives Maithili chao and Jaunsari chau six. Dang chɔᶸ fits this affricated branch and rounded ending, not the unextended ṣaṣ heading. Exact survey form tʃʰɔᶸ is preserved.
